scope: Independent local read-only audit of the v6 attempt's attempt/result/cleanup and runner/validation receipts, progress/event/timing journals, pod snapshot, and frozen v6 package. No provider/API access, cloud mutation, paid work, tests, or code changes were performed.

artifact_hashes.results/validation.json.status.json: same as validation.json; read-back comparison identical
artifact_hashes.results/runner-status.json: same as runner-receipt.json; read-back comparison identical

identity_and_package.readback: screen.verify_package() passed read-only for paired-collector-2026-10-11-v6; archive sizes/hashes and protected local-source bindings verified.
identity_and_package.image_provenance_limit: Runner receipt labels the image value as the frozen candidate declaration bound to controller pod read-back, not in-container attestation. The persisted pod.json omits image and registry fields, so this review does not claim independent container-image attestation.

lifecycle_and_budget.cost_interpretation: Estimate is fixed-cost assumption plus elapsed seconds at catalog compute rate plus the controller's storage allowance. It is not an invoice or wallet read; actual spend and current remaining original $12/10-hour boundaries are not established by these files.
lifecycle_and_budget.lifecycle_timing: Console log records about 58s from attempt start to SSH readiness, about 81s archive upload, about 4s helper upload, then cache verification and diagnostic. Result elapsed covers creation through retrieval and confirmed deletion. Pod snapshot was persisted before deletion; no current provider state is inferred.
lifecycle_and_budget.stale_lifecycle_field: attempt.json still has status=creating even though it contains the created pod ID and create_uncertain=false. result.json, runner receipts, logs and cleanup.json corroborate completion/deletion; treat attempt.json status as stale metadata, not authoritative terminal status.

measurement_receipt.full_coverage_interpretation: full_coverage=true means the frozen six-window diagnostic completed its own prescribed 12 pairs, 6 independent native inputs, and event counts; it is not full scientific-collection acceptance.
measurement_receipt.pairing: Six fixed windows cover C4/scientific/code at 2048 and 4096. The same three source documents/groups are matched across context lengths. Every window has one measured [15,0,7] pair and one measured [15] pair. Pair execution order alternates AB/BA evenly (3 each per shape). The native reference performs 24 per-expert checks per input.
measurement_receipt.event_checks: All measured arms have the expected input/event/token/target identities, matching routes and expert order, eight token_local_zero_contribution effects per requested layer, finite numerical values, and the frozen execution mode identities. All 12 pair comparisons report native_checks=pass.
measurement_receipt.cleanup_integrity: All six native_input_complete rows record cleanup_pass=true and parameters_unchanged=true; final receipt records parameter_versions_unchanged=true. Candidate/baseline per-arm checks pass in the paired receipt.
measurement_receipt.payload_checks: Receipt event/progress/timing digests match the local files; runner receipt hash matches validation.json; runner-status equals runner-receipt; validation status mirror equals validation.json; plan manifests, selection and candidate/baseline implementation IDs match the frozen v6 package. Independent timing reconciliation found all 24 measured timing-row measurement_seconds values match the paired summary exactly; all 24 measured paired_arm_complete progress rows include final end-to-end fields, and all 12 paired summary end-to-end values match those progress rows.

timing_results.measurement_seconds_definition: Per-arm collector measurement from the synchronized model operation through the post-operation synchronization. It excludes event/timing persistence.
timing_results.end_to_end_seconds_definition: Paired comparison end-to-end spans pre-arm synchronization through event journal and timing-row fsync; it excludes progress-sidecar writes and broader workflow setup/load/validation/retrieval/teardown.
timing_results.timing_sidecar_note: The timing JSONL has 28 rows and records measurement seconds plus the end-to-end duration before timing-sidecar fsync. The final timing-sidecar fsync duration and complete end-to-end value are added after the row is appended, so those final fields are absent from that row; paired comparison summaries and paired-arm completion progress carry the complete end-to-end values. Do not treat sidecar rows as including their own persistence cost.
timing_results.resource_observations: GPU event peak allocated memory 30,506,363,904 bytes and reserved memory 33,072,087,040 bytes; maximum recorded host RSS 27,907,668 KiB. These are observed peaks from this diagnostic, not an allocation bound or fit proof. Pod snapshot reports gpu.memory=125 and vcpuCount=16; this is host metadata and distinct from the receipt's GPU memory total.

confounds_and_inference_limits: This is six fixed diagnostic inputs, with three documents/source groups each represented at both contexts, not six independent content sources. There is one measured pair per input/shape and no repetition adequate for inferential speedup claims.

AB/BA order is balanced overall (three pairs per order for each shape), but every 4096-context pair is baseline-then-candidate and every 2048-context pair is candidate-then-baseline. Context-specific comparisons therefore confound context with arm order; pooled ratios across the six windows cannot separate any order-by-context interaction.
[15,0,7] always precedes [15] for each input, and the warmup schedule uses only [15,0,7]. Warm cache/kernel/order effects may influence the primary-only ratios.

Pooling is descriptive within each requested shape and uses sums of paired elapsed times. The two shapes perform different amounts of work and are not pooled together. Speed ratios do not establish 10k-window or full-workflow feasibility.
The receipt PASS is diagnostic-only. It does not replace the full technical validation gate, approve scientific collection, or provide a population-level performance claim.

review_findings.minor_record_quality_issue: attempt.json status remains creating; independently corroborated terminal records show remote_command_finished, runner PASS, and confirmed deletion.
review_findings.minor_timing_provenance_limit: The timing JSONL does not include its own fsync duration or complete end-to-end value in each row; these are represented in progress/receipt summaries as described above.
review_findings.image_identity_limit: Declared package image digest is not a cryptographic in-container attestation; saved pod.json also omits image/registry. Keep the explicit provenance caveat.
review_findings.current_provider_state: Not queried in this review; deletion is supported by local cleanup receipt and controller log only.

conclusion: Local receipt, raw journals, native comparison progress, lifecycle cleanup and frozen v6 package are internally hash-consistent. The diagnostic completed all 12 pairs, 144 independent native expert comparisons, 48 measured events and 12 warmup events with zero observed numerical differences and confirmed pod deletion while retaining the network volume. Pooled paired elapsed was 6.83% lower for [15,0,7] and 33.05% lower for [15] in these six fixed inputs. These are descriptive conditional measurements with order/warmup and small-sample limits; they do not establish full scientific acceptance, generalizable speedup or complete-workflow feasibility. No material measurement blocker was found. The stale attempt status and image-attestation boundary should remain visible in synthesized results.
reviewer_actions: Read raw artifacts and v6 package locally; verified hashes/counts/identities and recomputed paired aggregation and numerical discrepancy summaries in read-only inline scripts. No tests were launched.
